Subject: Post-discovery: schedule ML/Infra deep-dive (60-90m) and attendee request

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for taking the discovery call this morning. Really appreciate the context on your clinical NLP pilot and the throughput targets you shared. As discussed, the natural next step is a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with our ML and infra engineering leads so we can:

- Walk through expected model sizes and token/sequence distributions
- Outline runtime and quantization trade-offs for cost vs latency
- Validate data flows, retention, and key security controls (SOC2/KMS)

Can you confirm:
1) Target attendees on your side (eng/infra/security)
2) One or two 90-minute windows that work for your team in the week of Sep 9–13 (we can do 60 if you prefer)
3) Any must-have agenda items or constraints (air-gapped environment, specific PII redaction questions, etc.)

We can bring Marcus Lin (serving runtime) and Grace O'Connor (solutions) to run the session and answer infra questions. Proposed slots from our side:
- Tue Sep 10, 13:00–14:30 PDT
- Thu Sep 12, 10:00–11:30 PDT
I've attached a short mutual action plan and a prep checklist that helps us focus the session. If those slots don't work, paste a few that do and we'll adapt.

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference
